key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3 advising immediate evacuation for multiple coastal provinces.
Evacuations occurred; surveyed barangays reported about 80% of residents evacuated after the alert.
Communication problems caused delayed or distorted messages; power cuts, weak mobile signals, and one incorrect radio broadcast were noted.
No significant tsunami waves appeared and no damages were observed.
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred east of the southern tip of Eastern Samar.
At 09:01 pm PHIVOLCS issued alert level 3… including coastal areas of Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, Leyte, Southern Leyte, Surigao del Norte and Surigao del Sur.
All surveyed barangays had an estimated average of 80% of the residents evacuating after the alert.
missing_information: Specific evacuated barangays/municipalities not itemized; coastal areas referenced at provincial scale.
